faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Krishnagiri District Special Public Prosecutor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Krishnagiri District Special Public Prosecutor recruitment is 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Special Public Prosecutor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Special Public Prosecutor post in Krishnagiri District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Special Public Prosecutor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be an Advocate with a minimum of 10 years of practice as on the date of application submission.

faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.answer: The job type for the Special Public Prosecutor position is Contractual.
